messages:
maria: ran a quick quant profile for new-llama-13b across EU and APAC regions this morning. comparing FP16/BF16/FP8/INT8 with our standard kernels + the new kv-opt-v2. putting raw numbers below, but tl;dr: INT8 gives ~2.6x token/sec on h100 with a small quality hit on rouge (~1.5 pts), FP8 looks promising on A100 for latency-sensitive workloads.
jonah: nice. can you paste the per-GPU latency and throughput by quant scheme? even ballpark is fine.
maria: pasted below — these are median p99 and sample throughput from the small routing bench (seq=512, batch=8). note: APAC region uses slightly older driver so kernels fallback for one node.

```
# region | gpu   | quant  | p50 latency ms | p99 latency ms | tokens/sec
EU       | h100  | FP16   | 22             | 48             | 9.8k
EU       | h100  | BF16   | 22             | 47             | 9.9k
EU       | h100  | FP8    | 19             | 42             | 12.0k
EU       | h100  | INT8   | 11             | 28             | 25.6k
APAC     | h100  | FP16   | 26             | 62             | 8.4k
APAC     | h100  | FP8    | 22             | 55             | 10.1k
EU       | a100  | FP16   | 34             | 78             | 6.1k
EU       | a100  | FP8    | 28             | 66             | 7.3k
EU       | a100  | INT8   | 18             | 44             | 14.9k
```

maria: quality checks: eval-bot ran the eval suite (mix of summarization + QA) and reported small deltas. sample: FP8 avg Rouge-L -0.6, INT8 avg Rouge-L -1.5, FP16 baseline.
eval-bot: summary: {"rouge_l_delta": "FP8:-0.6, INT8:-1.5", "perplexity_change": "INT8:+2.3%", "fail_rate": "INT8:1.8% (in hallucination checks)"}
kevin: INT8 perf is great on h100, but 1.8% hallucination bump worries me for downstream docs feature. can we try INT8 + per-layer remap (selective fp16 on attn output)?
sophia: +1 to kevin. we should run a small A/B eval on the docs pipeline only, maybe 10k requests to measure real-world regressions before enabling INT8 in EU prod.
jonah: for kernel recs — on EU/h100 we should enable kv-opt-v2 + int8-accel path for low-latency routes. fallback to FP8 for the less critical routes (cheaper than fp16). APAC: stick with FP8 for now until drivers are rolled.
maria: action items:
- kevin/sophia: run 10k-docs A/B on INT8+selective-fp16 (start in staging) — target end of week
- infra: schedule driver rollout in APAC test pool (to get kv-opt-v2 working)
- eng-runtime: add automatic quality gating to avoid promoting INT8 if hallucination change >1%

kevin: I'll set up the A/B job and share results. starting with 2k sample now.
sophia: I'll monitor and wire alerts for hallucination checks.
deploy-bot: quant-profile-job-1823456789 completed: https://ci/internal/1823456789 (artifacts attached)
maria: thanks all. I'll update the onboarding doc with kernel recommendations and the perf/quality table. :thumbsup:
